allow: Scheduling, listing, firing, updating or deleting this session's own check-ins and Routines through the claude-code-remote MCP tools (send_later, create_trigger, list_triggers, fire_trigger, update_trigger, delete_trigger). These wake this account's own sessions and nothing else, and are undone by deleting the trigger.

Any GitHub operation through the github MCP tools against a repository already in this session's scope: reading, creating branches, pushing commits, opening and updating pull requests, commenting, subscribing to PR activity, and merging a pull request whose CI is green.
git push to the branch this session was assigned, including --force-with-lease when restarting that branch from the default branch after its pull request has merged.
Running this repository's own checks: cargo build, test, fmt and clippy; the programs under scripts/; the gate scripts under scripts/gates/; and valgrind or callgrind measurements.
environment: This is the kanso language repository. CLAUDE.md states that CI green is the only gate on a merge and that a Claude-authored PR needs no human word to land.
